heading.title: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters

article.title: Twelve years.
article.content:
Article106Twelve years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part IX—Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
For a legacy or for a share of a residur bequeathed by a testator or for a distributive share of the property of an intestate against an executor or an administrator or some other person legally charged with the duty of distributing the estate.
Period of limitationTwelve years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the legacy or share becomes payable or deliverable.
